planConnectionArgs.name: after
planConnectionArgs.description:
Takes in cursor from a previous search. Used for forward pagination. If earliest departure time
is used in the original query, the new search then returns itineraries that depart after
the start time of the last itinerary that was returned, or at the same time if there are multiple
itinerary options that can depart at that moment in time.
If latest arrival time is defined, the new search returns itineraries that arrive before the end
time of the last itinerary that was returned in the previous search, or at the same time if there
are multiple itinerary options that can arrive at that moment in time. This parameter is part of
the [GraphQL Cursor Connections Specification](https://relay.dev/graphql/connections.htm) and
should be used together with the `first` parameter.

planConnectionArgs.name: before
planConnectionArgs.description:
Takes in cursor from a previous search. Used for backwards pagination. If earliest departure time
is used in the original query, the new search then returns itineraries that depart before that time.
If latest arrival time is defined, the new search returns itineraries that arrive after that time.
This parameter is part of the [GraphQL Cursor Connections Specification](https://relay.dev/graphql/connections.htm)
and should be used together with the `last` parameter.

planConnectionArgs.name: dateTime
planConnectionArgs.description:
Datetime of the search. It's possible to either define the earliest departure time
or the latest arrival time. By default, earliest departure time is set as now.

planConnectionArgs.name: destination
planConnectionArgs.description: The destination where the search ends. Usually coordinates but can also be a stop location.

planConnectionArgs.name: first
planConnectionArgs.description:
How many new itineraries should at maximum be returned in either the first search or with
forward pagination. This parameter is part of the
[GraphQL Cursor Connections Specification](https://relay.dev/graphql/connections.htm)
and should be used together with the `after` parameter (although `after` shouldn't be defined
in the first search).

planConnectionArgs.name: flex
planConnectionArgs.description: Parameters that affect flexible transport routing per request.

planConnectionArgs.name: itineraryFilter
planConnectionArgs.description:
Settings that control the behavior of itinerary filtering. These are advanced settings and
should not be set by a user through user preferences.

planConnectionArgs.name: last
planConnectionArgs.description:
How many new itineraries should at maximum be returned in backwards pagination. It's recommended to
use the same value as was used for the `first` parameter in the original search for optimal
performance. This parameter is part of the
[GraphQL Cursor Connections Specification](https://relay.dev/graphql/connections.htm)
and should be used together with the `before` parameter.

planConnectionArgs.name: locale
planConnectionArgs.description:
Locale used for translations. Note, there might not necessarily be translations available.
It's possible and recommended to use the ´accept-language´ header instead of this parameter.

planConnectionArgs.name: modes
planConnectionArgs.description:
Street and transit modes used during the search. This also includes options to only return
an itinerary that contains no transit legs or force transit to be used in all itineraries.
By default, all transit modes are usable and `WALK` is used for direct street suggestions,
access, egress and transfers.

planConnectionArgs.name: origin
planConnectionArgs.description: The origin where the search starts. Usually coordinates but can also be a stop location.

planConnectionArgs.name: preferences
planConnectionArgs.description: Preferences that affect what itineraries are returned. Preferences are split into categories.

planConnectionArgs.name: searchWindow
planConnectionArgs.description:
Duration of the search window. This either starts at the defined earliest departure
time or ends at the latest arrival time. If this is not provided or the value is set as null,
a reasonable search window is automatically generated. When searching for earlier or later itineraries
with paging, this search window is no longer used and the new window will be based
on how many suggestions were returned in the previous search. The new search window can be
shorter or longer than the original search window. Note, itineraries are returned faster
with a smaller search window and search window limitation is done mainly for performance reasons.
    
Setting this parameter makes especially sense if the transportation network is as sparse or dense
in the whole itinerary search area. Otherwise, letting the system decide what is the search window
is in combination of using paging can lead to better performance and to getting a more consistent
number of itineraries in each search.

planConnectionArgs.name: via
planConnectionArgs.description: The list of points the itinerary is required to pass through.

PlanModesInput.name: PlanModesInput
PlanModesInput.description: Mode selections for the plan search.

inputFields.name: direct
inputFields.description:
Street mode that is used when searching for itineraries that don't use any transit.
If more than one mode is selected, at least one of them must be used but not necessarily all.
There are modes that automatically also use walking such as the rental modes. To force rental
to be used, this should only include the rental mode and not `WALK` in addition.

inputFields.name: directOnly
inputFields.description: Should only the direct search without any transit be done.

inputFields.name: transit
inputFields.description:
Modes for different phases of an itinerary when transit is included. Also
includes street mode selections related to connecting to the transit network
and transfers. By default, all transit modes are usable.

inputFields.name: transitOnly
inputFields.description:
Should only the transit search be done and never suggest itineraries that don't
contain any transit legs.

PlanTransitModesInput.name: PlanTransitModesInput
PlanTransitModesInput.description:
Modes for different phases of an itinerary when transit is included. Also includes street
mode selections related to connecting to the transit network and transfers.

inputFields.name: access
inputFields.description:
Street mode that is used when searching for access to the transit network from origin.
If more than one mode is selected, at least one of them must be used but not necessarily all.
There are modes that automatically also use walking such as the rental modes. To force rental
to be used, this should only include the rental mode and not `WALK` in addition.

inputFields.name: egress
inputFields.description:
Street mode that is used when searching for egress to destination from the transit network.
If more than one mode is selected, at least one of them must be used but not necessarily all.
There are modes that automatically also use walking such as the rental modes. To force rental
to be used, this should only include the rental mode and not `WALK` in addition.

inputFields.name: transfer
inputFields.description: Street mode that is used when searching for transfers. Selection of only one allowed for now.

inputFields.name: transit
inputFields.description:
Transit modes and reluctances associated with them. Each defined mode can be used in
an itinerary but doesn't have to be. If direct search is not disabled, there can be an
itinerary without any transit legs. By default, all transit modes are usable. For a transit trip
to match PlanTransitModesInput, it must match one of the PlanTransitModePreferenceInputs given
in the field.
inputFields.defaultValue: [{mode : AIRPLANE}, {mode : BUS}, {mode : CABLE_CAR}, {mode : CARPOOL}, {mode : COACH}, {mode : FERRY}, {mode : FUNICULAR}, {mode : GONDOLA}, {mode : MONORAIL}, {mode : RAIL}, {mode : SNOW_AND_ICE}, {mode : SUBWAY}, {mode : TAXI}, {mode : TRAM}, {mode : TROLLEYBUS}]

PlanTransitModePreferenceInput.name: PlanTransitModePreferenceInput
PlanTransitModePreferenceInput.description: Transit mode and a reluctance associated with it.

inputFields.name: cost
inputFields.description: Costs related to using a transit mode.

inputFields.name: mode
inputFields.description: Transit mode that could be (but doesn't have to be) used in an itinerary.

inputFields.name: replacement
inputFields.description:
If present and not null, further limits the transit mode selection.  A transit trip matches
a PlanTransitModePreferenceInput if the mandatory TransitMode field mode matches. If replacement
is REQUIRED, the trip must also be a replacement. If replacement is FORBIDDEN,
the trip must not be a replacement. If replacement is FEATURE_IGNORED or missing, it
does not matter if the trip is a replacement or not. Whether a leg is a replacement is recognized
both by the NeTEx submode and the GTFS extended type, depending on the data source.
Note that a bus replacing a train has mode: BUS, replacement: true, so it matches a query with
mode: BUS, replacement: REQUIRED and mode: BUS, replacement: FEATURE_IGNORED, but it does not
match mode: TRAIN with any replacement options. So to get both trains and buses replacing them,
but no other buses, query [(mode: TRAIN), (mode: BUS, replacement: REQUIRED)].

TransitMode.name: TransitMode
TransitMode.description:
Transit modes include modes that are used within organized transportation networks
run by public transportation authorities, taxi companies etc.
Equivalent to GTFS route_type or to NeTEx TransportMode.

enumValues.name: CARPOOL
enumValues.description: Private car trips shared with others.

enumValues.name: MONORAIL
enumValues.description: Railway in which the track consists of a single rail or a beam.

enumValues.name: RAIL
enumValues.description: This includes long or short distance trains.

enumValues.name: SNOW_AND_ICE
enumValues.description: Used for off-road snow and ice vehicles

enumValues.name: SUBWAY
enumValues.description: Subway or metro, depending on the local terminology.

enumValues.name: TAXI
enumValues.description: A taxi, possibly operated by a public transport agency.

enumValues.name: TROLLEYBUS
enumValues.description: Electric buses that draw power from overhead wires using poles.

PlanAccessMode.name: PlanAccessMode
PlanAccessMode.description: Street modes that can be used for access to the transit network from origin.

enumValues.name: BICYCLE
enumValues.description:
Cycling to a stop and boarding a vehicle with the bicycle.
Note, this can include walking when it's needed to walk the bicycle.
Access can use cycling only if the mode used for transfers
and egress is also `BICYCLE`.

enumValues.name: BICYCLE_PARKING
enumValues.description:
Starting the itinerary with a bicycle and parking the bicycle to
a parking location. Note, this can include walking after parking

car.

enumValues.name: FLEX

Flexible transit. This can include different forms of flexible transit that

PlanPreferencesInput.name: PlanPreferencesInput
PlanPreferencesInput.description: Wrapper type for different types of preferences related to plan query.

inputFields.name: accessibility
inputFields.description: Accessibility preferences that affect both the street and transit routing.

inputFields.name: street
inputFields.description:
Street routing preferences used for ingress, egress and transfers. These do not directly affect
the transit legs but can change how preferable walking or cycling, for example, is compared to
transit.

inputFields.name: transit
inputFields.description: Transit routing preferences used for transit legs.

TransitPreferencesInput.name: TransitPreferencesInput
TransitPreferencesInput.description: Transit routing preferences used for transit legs.

inputFields.name: alight
inputFields.description: Preferences related to alighting from a transit vehicle.

inputFields.name: board
inputFields.description:
Preferences related to boarding a transit vehicle. Note, board costs for each street mode
can be found under the street mode preferences.

inputFields.name: filters
relaxTransitGroupPriority
inputFields.description:
Relax generalized-cost when comparing itineraries with a different set of
transit-group-priorities. The groups are set server side for routes and
can not be configured in the API.
  
This relaxes the comparison inside the routing engine for each stop-arrival. If two
paths have a different set of transit-group-priorities, then the generalized-cost
comparison is relaxed. The final set of paths are filtered through the normal
itinerary-filters.
  
A relax-cost is used to increase the limit when comparing one cost to another cost
using a linear function applied to the generalized cost.
This is used to include more results into the result. A `coefficient=2.0` means a path (itinerary)
with twice as high cost as another one, is accepted. A `constant=300` means a "fixed"
constant is added to the limit.

inputFields.name: timetable
inputFields.description: Preferences related to cancellations and real-time.

inputFields.name: transfer
inputFields.description: Preferences related to transfers between transit vehicles (typically between stops).

TransitFilterInput.name: TransitFilterInput
TransitFilterInput.description:
A collection of selectors for what routes/agencies should be included in or excluded from the search.

The `include` is always applied to select the initial set, then `exclude` to remove elements.
If only `exclude` is present, the exclude is applied to the existing set of results.

Therefore, if an entity is both included _and_ excluded the exclusion takes precedence.

inputFields.name: exclude
inputFields.description:
A list of selectors for what routes/agencies should be excluded during search.
  
In order to be excluded, a route/agency has to match with at least one selector.
  
An empty list or a list containing `null` is forbidden.

inputFields.name: include
inputFields.description:
A list of selectors for what routes/agencies should be allowed during the search.
  
If route/agency matches with at least one selector it will be included.
  
An empty list or a list containing `null` is forbidden.

TransitFilterSelectInput.name: TransitFilterSelectInput
TransitFilterSelectInput.description:
A list of selectors for including or excluding entities from the routing results. Null
means everything is allowed to be returned and empty lists are not allowed.

inputFields.name: agencies
inputFields.description:
Set of ids for agencies that should be included in/excluded from the search.
  
Format: `FeedId:AgencyId`

inputFields.name: routes
inputFields.description:
Set of ids for routes that should be included in/excluded from the search.
  
Format: `FeedId:AgencyId`

PlanLabeledLocationInput.name: PlanLabeledLocationInput
PlanLabeledLocationInput.description:
Plan location settings. Location must be set. Label is optional
and used for naming the location.

inputFields.name: label
inputFields.description:
A label that can be attached to the location. This label is then returned with the location
in the itineraries.

inputFields.name: location
inputFields.description: A location that has to be used in an itinerary.

PlanLocationInput.name: PlanLocationInput
PlanLocationInput.description: Plan location. Either a coordinate or a stop location should be defined.

inputFields.name: coordinate
inputFields.description: Coordinate of the location. Note, either a coordinate or a stop location should be defined.

inputFields.name: stopLocation
inputFields.description:
Stop, station, a group of stop places or multimodal stop place that should be used as
a location for the search. The trip doesn't have to use the given stop location for a
transit connection as it's possible to start walking to another stop from the given
location. If a station or a group of stop places is provided, a stop that makes the most
sense for the journey is picked as the location within the station or group of stop places.

PlanCoordinateInput.name: PlanCoordinateInput
PlanCoordinateInput.description: A coordinate used for a location in a plan query.

inputFields.name: latitude
inputFields.description: Latitude as a WGS84 format number.

inputFields.name: longitude
inputFields.description: Longitude as a WGS84 format number.

PlanDateTimeInput.name: PlanDateTimeInput
PlanDateTimeInput.description: Plan date time options. Only one of the values should be defined.

inputFields.name: earliestDeparture
inputFields.description:
Earliest departure date time. The returned itineraries should not
depart before this instant unless one is using paging to find earlier
itineraries. Note, it is not currently possible to define both
`earliestDeparture` and `latestArrival`.

inputFields.name: latestArrival
inputFields.description:
Latest arrival time date time. The returned itineraries should not
arrive to the destination after this instant unless one is using
paging to find later itineraries. Note, it is not currently possible
to define both `earliestDeparture` and `latestArrival`.

PlanStreetPreferencesInput.name: PlanStreetPreferencesInput
PlanStreetPreferencesInput.description:
Street routing preferences used for ingress, egress and transfers. These do not directly affect
the transit legs but can change how preferable walking or cycling, for example, is compared to
transit.

inputFields.name: bicycle
inputFields.description: Cycling related preferences.

inputFields.name: car
inputFields.description:
Car related preferences. These are not used for car travel as part of transit, such as
taxi travel.

inputFields.name: scooter
inputFields.description: Scooter (kick or electrical) related preferences.

inputFields.name: walk
inputFields.description:
Walk related preferences. These are not used when walking a bicycle or a scooter as they
have their own preferences.

CarPreferencesInput.name: CarPreferencesInput
CarPreferencesInput.description: Preferences related to traveling on a car (excluding car travel on transit services such as taxi).

inputFields.name: boardCost
inputFields.description: Cost of boarding a vehicle with a car.

inputFields.name: parking
inputFields.description: Car parking related preferences.

inputFields.name: reluctance
inputFields.description: A multiplier for how bad travelling on car is compared to being in transit for equal lengths of time.

inputFields.name: rental
inputFields.description: Car rental related preferences.

WalkPreferencesInput.name: WalkPreferencesInput
WalkPreferencesInput.description: Preferences related to walking (excluding walking a bicycle or a scooter).

inputFields.name: boardCost
inputFields.description: The cost of boarding a vehicle while walking.

inputFields.name: reluctance
inputFields.description: A multiplier for how bad walking is compared to being in transit for equal lengths of time.

inputFields.name: safetyFactor
inputFields.description:
Factor for how much the walk safety is considered in routing. Value should be between 0 and 1.
If the value is set to be 0, safety is ignored.

inputFields.name: speed
inputFields.description:
Maximum walk speed on flat ground. Note, this speed is higher than the average speed
will be in itineraries as this is the maximum speed but there are
factors that slow down walking such as crossings, intersections and elevation changes.

TransitModePreferenceCostInput.name: TransitModePreferenceCostInput
TransitModePreferenceCostInput.description: Costs related to using a transit mode.

inputFields.name: reluctance
inputFields.description: A cost multiplier of transit leg travel time.

ReplacementFilterInput.name: ReplacementFilterInput
ReplacementFilterInput.description: Contains details on how to filter trips based on the replacement feature when considering them for routing.

inputFields.name: requirement
inputFields.description: One of three choices: must be replacement, cannot be a replacement, can either be or not be a replacement

PlanItineraryFilterInput.name: PlanItineraryFilterInput
PlanItineraryFilterInput.description:
Settings that control the behavior of itinerary filtering. **These are advanced settings and
should not be set by a user through user preferences.**

inputFields.name: groupSimilarityKeepOne
inputFields.description:
Pick one itinerary from each group after putting itineraries that are `85%` similar together,
if the given value is `0.85`, for example. Itineraries are grouped together based on relative
the distance of transit travel that is identical between the itineraries (access, egress and
transfers are ignored). The value must be at least `0.5`.

inputFields.name: groupSimilarityKeepThree
inputFields.description:
Pick three itineraries from each group after putting itineraries that are `68%` similar together,
if the given value is `0.68`, for example. Itineraries are grouped together based on relative
the distance of transit travel that is identical between the itineraries (access, egress and
transfers are ignored). The value must be at least `0.5`.

inputFields.name: groupedOtherThanSameLegsMaxCostMultiplier
inputFields.description:
Of the itineraries grouped to maximum of three itineraries, how much worse can the non-grouped
legs be compared to the lowest cost. `2.0` means that they can be double the cost, and any
itineraries having a higher cost will be filtered away. Use a value lower than `1.0` to turn the
grouping off.

inputFields.name: itineraryFilterDebugProfile
inputFields.description: Itinerary filter debug profile used to control the behaviour of itinerary filters.

PlanViaLocationInput.name: PlanViaLocationInput
PlanViaLocationInput.description:
A via-location is used to specifying a location as an intermediate place the router must
route through. The via-location is either a pass-through-location or a visit-via-location.

inputFields.name: passThrough
inputFields.description: Board, alight or pass-through(on-board) at the stop location.

inputFields.name: visit
inputFields.description: Board or alight at a stop location or visit a coordinate.
